mapper.select: SELECT client_id AS clientId, media_type AS mediaType, media_id AS mediaId, title, pic, starred, starred_at AS starredAt, last_visit_at AS lastVisitAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_acgn_library WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY last_visit_at DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT client_id AS clientId, media_type AS mediaType, media_id AS mediaId, title, pic, starred, starred_at AS starredAt, last_visit_at AS lastVisitAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_acgn_library WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND media_type = #{mediaType} AND media_id = #{mediaId}

SELECT client_id AS clientId, media_type AS mediaType, media_id AS mediaId, title, pic, subscribed_at AS subscribedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_acgn_subscribe WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY subscribed_at DESC LIMIT 400
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 0721acgn.tb_acgn_subscribe (client_id, media_type, media_id, title, pic, subscribed_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaId}, #{title}, #{pic}, #{subscribedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT client_id AS clientId, media_type AS mediaType, media_id AS mediaId, payload_json AS payloadJson, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM 0721acgn.tb_acgn_progress WHERE client_id = #{clientId} LIMIT 2000
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 0721acgn.tb_acgn_progress (client_id, media_type, media_id, payload_json, updated_at) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{mediaType}, #{mediaId}, #{payloadJson}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_json = VALUES(payload_json), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
